records.name: Oddkin/Common/button
records.description: Primary, secondary and ghost actions. Small 32 / medium 40 / large 48 px; focus and busy states. Existing @oddkin/components implementation; extra visual states remain specifications.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/iconButton
records.description: A compact action with a visible focus ring and a required accessible name. Design proposal; not a promised custom-element API.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/toggleButton
records.description: An action with a persistent pressed state; pair colour with an inset marker. Design proposal; not a promised custom-element API. Selection/value and interaction state are independent axes; original component IDs retained.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/link
records.description: A native destination, with a clear underline on interaction and a visible focus indicator. Design proposal; not a promised custom-element API.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/badge
records.description: Passive status or count. Use words and a marker; do not style it as an action. Design proposal; not a promised custom-element API.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/chip
records.description: A compact token with an explicit remove target; selected chips use the selection roles. Design proposal; not a promised custom-element API.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/button/sm
records.description: Canonical sm button family. All appearance and interaction states; original variant IDs preserved.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/button/lg
records.description: Canonical lg button family. All appearance and interaction states; original variant IDs preserved.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/field
records.description: Label → description → control → validation. Required state is written as well as marked. Design proposal; not a promised custom-element API.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/input
records.description: One-line text. Email, URL, telephone and password share this anatomy; native semantics remain intact. Existing @oddkin/components implementation; extra visual states remain specifications.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/textarea
records.description: Multiline text with a persistent label, helpful limit and optional validation. Design proposal; not a promised custom-element API.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/search
records.description: A search landmark or labelled field, with a clear action after text is entered. Design proposal; not a promised custom-element API.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/checkbox
records.description: Independent choices. Checked and mixed states always include a non-colour marker. Design proposal; not a promised custom-element API. Selection/value and interaction state are independent axes; original component IDs retained.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/radio
records.description: One choice within a named group; the dot remains visible in the selected state. Design proposal; not a promised custom-element API. Selection/value and interaction state are independent axes; original component IDs retained.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/switch
records.description: An immediate on / off setting; thumb position and written value express the state. Design proposal; not a promised custom-element API. Selection/value and interaction state are independent axes; original component IDs retained.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/slider
records.description: Adjust a bounded value, with the current value and labelled endpoints visible. Design proposal; not a promised custom-element API.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/ListboxSurface
records.description: Shared list body for select, combobox, multiselect and standalone listbox. Its rows are instances of ListboxOption, with editable label, divider and selection/focus/disabled variants. No outer border or shadow; those belong to the composed control.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/ListboxOption
records.description:
Reusable value option. Selection and keyboard interaction are independent. Used for persistent listboxes and selection popups; disabled choices cannot be committed.

Focus outline: 2 px stroke, 4 px equal inset derived from focus width + offset, and the radius/sm 4 px corner token. Matches select and combobox; the focused row omits its divider.
Shared styling: overlays use color.surface.raised, control.radius, border.width.default, color.border.default, and the mode-aware Oddkin/Overlay effect (elevation.md). Selected rows use color.selection.surface, separately from color.surface.hover.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/CheckboxOption
records.description:
Checkbox option row. Uses the Common checkbox primitive, 40 px listbox row height, token colors, and a rounded 4 px inset keyboard focus indicator.
Shared styling: overlays use color.surface.raised, control.radius, border.width.default, color.border.default, and the mode-aware Oddkin/Overlay effect (elevation.md). Selected rows use color.selection.surface, separately from color.surface.hover.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/MenuItem
records.description: Action label, optional icon, shortcut, and sub-menu indicator. Design proposal; not a promised custom-element API.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/NavigationItem
records.description: Shared navigation entry used by side navigation and tree leaves. Spacing, padding and minimum height bind to the repository navigation.* roles. Current entries use the shared action bar and semibold UI text. Side navigation shows an upward chevron when expanded and a downward chevron when collapsed, matching side-nav.styles.ts.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/CommandItem
records.description: Search result or command option. Active keyboard focus is independent of execution. Reuse inside command palettes.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/Disclosure
records.description: One trigger reveals or hides one related content region. Design proposal; not a promised custom-element API.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/tooltip
records.description:
Brief supplementary text; never the only accessible label. Design proposal; not a promised custom-element API.
Shared styling: overlays use color.surface.raised, control.radius, border.width.default, color.border.default, and the mode-aware Oddkin/Overlay effect (elevation.md). Selected rows use color.selection.surface, separately from color.surface.hover.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/progress
records.description: Known progress is explicit; unknown progress never shows a percentage. Design proposal; not a promised custom-element API.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/spinner
records.description: A small busy indicator paired with a meaningful status label. Design proposal; not a promised custom-element API.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/skeleton
records.description: A temporary content-shaped placeholder while a region loads. Design proposal; not a promised custom-element API.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/avatar
records.description: A person or group marker with an accessible name. Design proposal; not a promised custom-element API.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/icon
records.description: A restrained 20px icon vocabulary; decorative icons stay silent. Design proposal; not a promised custom-element API.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/divider
records.description: A subtle boundary between related groups of content. Design proposal; not a promised custom-element API.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/typography
records.description: All eight canonical text roles, mapped to the repository scales. Design proposal; not a promised custom-element API.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/keyboardKey
records.description: Display a keyboard shortcut without making it look clickable. Design proposal; not a promised custom-element API.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/avatar/Appearance
records.description: Reusable avatar appearance variants. Background: Neutral, Brand, Success, Warning, Danger, Custom. Shape: Square (0), Small radius (4), Rounded (8), Circle (full). Initials are exposed from the shared AvatarItem. Native Figma custom HEX colors are set on the nested Avatar Fill; foreground is independently overridable.

records.description: Selected-value renderer for display="count". Count uses the same Amelia, Noah, Olivia, Liam member dataset. Width-sensitive previews may reduce visible values and update the hidden count.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/multiselect/Value/text

records.name: Oddkin/Common/multiselect/Value/auto
records.description: Selected-value renderer for display="auto". Count uses the same Amelia, Noah, Olivia, Liam member dataset. Width-sensitive previews may reduce visible values and update the hidden count.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/multiselect/Value/expandable
records.description: Selected-value renderer for display="expandable". Count uses the same Amelia, Noah, Olivia, Liam member dataset. Width-sensitive previews may reduce visible values and update the hidden count.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/multiselect/Value/avatars
records.description: Selected-value renderer for display="avatars". Count uses the same Amelia, Noah, Olivia, Liam member dataset. Width-sensitive previews may reduce visible values and update the hidden count.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/multiselect/Value/grouped
records.description: Selected-value renderer for display="grouped". Count uses the same Amelia, Noah, Olivia, Liam member dataset. Width-sensitive previews may reduce visible values and update the hidden count.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/multiselect/Field
records.description: 48 px trigger using Oddkin control tokens. Inset rounded focus stays inside the border. Status states preserve existing selections.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/AvatarItem
records.description: 32 px initials fallback for a person. Name is conveyed in the multiselect summary and selected-items review.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/GridCell
records.description: Interactive data-grid cell. Focus is distinct from row selection. Editing and invalid content have explicit visual treatments.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/GridColumnHeader
records.description: Column header with explicit sort direction. Activate to cycle sorting; expose sort semantics in the implementation.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/GridSelection
records.description: Grid row selection control. Requires an accessible row-specific label; select-all uses the existing mixed checkbox state.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/Splitter/vertical
records.description: Vertical separator resizes left/right panes. Arrow Left/Right adjusts size; Home/End move to allowed limits; Enter collapses or restores the primary pane. Focus remains visible.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/Splitter/horizontal
records.description: Horizontal separator resizes top/bottom panes. Arrow Up/Down adjusts size; Home/End moves to limits. Label the affected panes and expose current/minimum/maximum sizes.

records.name: Oddkin/Layout/SpecimenItem
records.description: Demo content only. A replaceable child for layout examples, using existing Oddkin typography, surface, border and radius roles.

records.name: Oddkin/Layout/Box
records.description: Inset wrapper. Uses layout.inset (24 px) by default; None and Roomy use the existing 0 and 32 px steps. CSS pattern: padding with min-inline-size: 0; not a separate shipped helper.

records.name: Oddkin/Layout/Container
records.description: A named inline-size container and optional content measure. Fluid content fills available space; the constrained example uses a recipe-local 40rem maximum, centered. This is a CSS recipe pattern, not a shipped container() helper. Children own their response rules.

records.name: Oddkin/Layout/Stack
records.description: stack() / .odd-stack: vertical flow, full-width children and layout.gap (16 px) by default. Tight and Loose reuse space.xs (8 px) and space.lg (24 px). Content slot accepts arbitrary children.

records.name: Oddkin/Layout/Row
records.description: row() / .odd-row: non-wrapping horizontal flow, centered on the cross axis. Default gap is layout.gap (16 px). Between maps to justify-content: space-between. Fixed 80 px children demonstrate unchanged widths.

records.name: Oddkin/Layout/Cluster
records.description: row({wrap:true}) / .odd-cluster: intrinsic wrapping with layout.gap (16 px) in both axes. The example uses six 96 px children; available width determines how many fit per row. No breakpoint or viewport query is required.

records.name: Oddkin/Layout/Grid
records.description: grid({columns}) / .odd-grid: equal minmax(0,1fr) columns, a 16 px gap and content-sized rows. The Columns property offers 1–4 as common presets; the code helper supports 1–24. Each cell is a native editable slot. Column count changes only when configured or selected by a recipe rule.

records.name: Oddkin/Layout/AutoGrid
records.description: autoGrid() / .odd-auto-grid: repeat(auto-fill,minmax(min(layout.item-min,100%),1fr)). Defaults: item-min 256 px, gap 16 px. Intrinsic 1/2/3-column response at 320/640/960 px. Figma wrapping uses minimum-width children; CSS additionally clamps the minimum below 256 px.

records.name: Oddkin/Layout/Split
records.description: split() / .odd-split: sidebar basis 256 px, main minimum 320 px, gap 16 px. Intrinsic CSS wrap threshold is 592 px; the Figma Arrangement variants show the corresponding stacked/side-by-side states. Figma does not automatically swap variants when resized. CSS distributes remaining width with side/main flex-grow 1:999; the Figma side-by-side state holds the preferred 256 px sidebar basis.

records.name: Oddkin/Layout/Center
records.description: Centered content pattern using CSS grid place-items:center or flex alignment. This example centers a 256 px content slot within a 192 px-high region; those dimensions are example configuration. No center() helper is currently shipped.

records.name: Oddkin/Layout/AspectRatio
records.description: Aspect-ratio container pattern. Native locked ratios preserve proportion as width changes; content slot fills the surface. Use aspect-ratio with min-inline-size:0 in a recipe. Not a shipped named helper.

records.name: Oddkin/Layout/ScrollRegion
records.description: Bounded scroll region pattern: 192 px example block-size, overflow-y:auto and min-block-size:0. Six stacked children remain full-width with a 16 px gap. Content intentionally clips at the viewport boundary; scroll in presentation to inspect the rest. Not a shipped named helper.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/calendar/Day
records.description: Calendar day. Monday-first seven-column grid; 40px cells. Today and selection are distinct; inset focus avoids adjacent cells. Day label is editable. Figma design proposal; no runtime component is registered by this design.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/oneTimeCode/Cell
records.description: Single editable numeric code cell. 40 × 48; 8px inter-cell spacing. Keyboard focus reserves 4px outside the cell. Figma design proposal; no runtime component is registered by this design.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/color/Swatch
records.description: Selected color is user data (#2563EB sample), intentionally not a theme role. Change the editable fill for a custom hex value; border, radius, check and focus use Oddkin tokens. Figma design proposal; no runtime component is registered by this design.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/rating/Item
records.description: Five-star rating item. 32px target, 20px original Oddkin star. Selected value is reinforced by visible numeric summary. Figma design proposal; no runtime component is registered by this design.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/rating
records.description: Single-choice five-star rating with explicit numeric value. Empty, chosen, keyboard, validation, disabled and read-only examples. Figma design proposal; no runtime component is registered by this design.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/number
records.description: A native numeric field with separate decrement and increment controls where appropriate. Design proposal; not a promised custom-element API. Custom decrement/increment targets are centered in the existing 40px field. Added minimum, maximum and invalid examples; runtime still uses the native number spinner.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/stat
records.description: Single metric with label, value and comparison context. Trend direction uses an arrow and signed value; no assumed positive/negative business meaning. Figma design proposal; no runtime component is registered by this design.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/copyButton
records.description: Copy action reuses the small secondary button and original copy/check icons. Success text is available to an announced status; errors offer a manual-copy fallback. Figma design proposal; no runtime component is registered by this design.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/relativeTime
records.description: Display a localized relative timestamp backed by an absolute datetime. Absolute detail is accessible on hover/focus or as accompanying text; this is not a live clock prototype. Figma design proposal; no runtime component is registered by this design.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/select
records.description:
Open controls use one shared outer border, the 8 px control/radius token, and the Oddkin md elevation style around input and popup. Input, separator, and popup fill the same width; the separator uses the 1 px border token. Continuous 40 px menu rows use a neutral selected fill, accent checkmark, and inset dividers. Focus uses a 2 px stroke, 4 px inset derived from width + offset, and 4 px radius/sm corners. Permanent labels identify each example.
Shared styling: overlays use color.surface.raised, control.radius, border.width.default, color.border.default, and the mode-aware Oddkin/Overlay effect (elevation.md). Selected rows use color.selection.surface, separately from color.surface.hover.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/listbox
records.description:
Persistent form choices, with selection and keyboard focus shown separately. Design proposal; not a promised custom-element API. Includes explicit asynchronous/empty/recovery examples.

Focus outline: 2 px stroke, 4 px equal inset derived from focus width + offset, and the radius/sm 4 px corner token. Matches select and combobox; the focused row omits its divider.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/combobox
records.description:
Open controls use one shared outer border, the 8 px control/radius token, and the Oddkin md elevation style around input and popup. Input, separator, and popup fill the same width; the separator uses the 1 px border token. Continuous 40 px menu rows use a neutral selected fill, accent checkmark, and inset dividers. Focus uses a 2 px stroke, 4 px inset derived from width + offset, and 4 px radius/sm corners. Permanent labels identify each example.
Shared styling: overlays use color.surface.raised, control.radius, border.width.default, color.border.default, and the mode-aware Oddkin/Overlay effect (elevation.md). Selected rows use color.selection.surface, separately from color.surface.hover.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/multiselect
records.description:
Base multiselect interaction-state examples. Display strategies, high-density selection management, and supporting parts are documented in this same Multiselect section.
Shared styling: overlays use color.surface.raised, control.radius, border.width.default, color.border.default, and the mode-aware Oddkin/Overlay effect (elevation.md). Selected rows use color.selection.surface, separately from color.surface.hover.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/multiselect/Display
records.description: High-density multiselect exploration. Independent nested properties: Display; Count; Field State; Clearable; later Selection panel. Proposed APIs are not existing Oddkin code contracts. Default recommendation: auto, collapseAt=4, tabbed selection management.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/multiselect/SelectionPanel
records.description:
Selection management is independent from value display. Unified, tabbed, inline, and desktop dual-pane layouts share SelectionOption instances. Scroll viewports are bounded. Counts describe this local 120-member example; remote lists use loaded/filtered counts.
Shared styling: overlays use color.surface.raised, control.radius, border.width.default, color.border.default, and the mode-aware Oddkin/Overlay effect (elevation.md). Selected rows use color.selection.surface, separately from color.surface.hover.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/multiselect/InteractionExamples
records.description: Interactive high-density multiselect flow: open overflow, remove a visible or hidden selection, clear all, select/deselect four loaded filtered results, reopen with the same selection, and expand/collapse selected chips. Text entry is represented by the prefilled Ari state.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/multiselect/SelectedItems
records.description: Bounded selected-items manager for expandable chips. 160 px internal scrolling area. Removal acts on the same selection model as menu rows.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/radioGroup
records.description: A visible group label and one shared value, with descriptions for each option. Design proposal; not a promised custom-element API.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/segmented
records.description: A single form value from a small set. Use Tabs when changing content panels. Design proposal; not a promised custom-element API.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/dateTime
records.description: Native date and time anatomy. Calendar and time-picker behavior stays platform appropriate. Design proposal; not a promised custom-element API.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/fileUpload
records.description: An explicit file chooser, accepted types and a removable uploaded-file row. Design proposal; not a promised custom-element API.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/CheckboxGroup
records.description: Named group of independent checkbox choices with a legend, description and shared validation message. Child choices retain independent selection and interaction state.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/ValidationSummary
records.description: Form-level validation summary. On failed submission focus this summary; each listed error links to the matching invalid control. Preserve entered values.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/Form
records.description: Reusable settings form composition. Editing, field validation, submission, success, retryable failure and dirty-state feedback. Design specification; runtime form semantics and focus management must be implemented.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/Menu
records.description:
Actions in a popup; values belong in a select or listbox. Design proposal; not a promised custom-element API.
Shared styling: overlays use color.surface.raised, control.radius, border.width.default, color.border.default, and the mode-aware Oddkin/Overlay effect (elevation.md). Selected rows use color.selection.surface, separately from color.surface.hover.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/Tree
records.description: Hierarchical items with independent expansion, focus, and selection. Design proposal; not a promised custom-element API. Includes explicit asynchronous/empty/recovery examples.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/Table
records.description: Readable tabular records; an interactive grid is a separate pattern. Design proposal; not a promised custom-element API. Includes explicit asynchronous/empty/recovery examples.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/List
records.description: Repeated content with a clear hierarchy and optional trailing action. Design proposal; not a promised custom-element API.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/SideNavigation
records.description: Existing @oddkin/components side navigation. Native destination links and independent disclosure groups. Additional states in this kit are design specifications.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/Breadcrumbs
records.description: A location trail; the current page is text, preceding items are links. Design proposal; not a promised custom-element API.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/Pagination
records.description: Page navigation with current position and explicit previous / next. Design proposal; not a promised custom-element API.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/Tabs
records.description: Choose a related panel; selected and keyboard-focused tabs may differ. Design proposal; not a promised custom-element API.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/Accordion
records.description: A coordinated set of disclosures; expansion policy is explicit. Design proposal; not a promised custom-element API.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/Toolbar
records.description: Related actions in a named group, with a selection-aware alternative. Design proposal; not a promised custom-element API.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/splitAction
records.description: A primary action with a separate menu trigger; preserve two independent targets. Design proposal; not a promised custom-element API.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/card
records.description: Grouped content with an optional header, body, and action. Existing @oddkin/components implementation; extra visual states remain specifications.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/popover
records.description:
A temporary contextual surface anchored to its trigger. Design proposal; not a promised custom-element API.
Shared styling: overlays use color.surface.raised, control.radius, border.width.default, color.border.default, and the mode-aware Oddkin/Overlay effect (elevation.md). Selected rows use color.selection.surface, separately from color.surface.hover.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/dialog
records.description: A focused task with a title, body, and explicit actions. Design proposal; not a promised custom-element API.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/alertDialog
records.description: A consequential choice with a clear safe exit. Design proposal; not a promised custom-element API.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/drawer
records.description: A side panel that preserves the surrounding task context. Design proposal; not a promised custom-element API.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/alert
records.description: Persistent inline status, using an icon and words as well as colour. Design proposal; not a promised custom-element API.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/toast
records.description: A concise event result with an optional recovery action. Design proposal; not a promised custom-element API.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/emptyState
records.description: Explain an empty result and offer the next useful step. Design proposal; not a promised custom-element API.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/CommandPalette
records.description: Global command search. On open, focus the input; arrows navigate results, Enter executes, Escape dismisses and restores trigger focus. Loading, no results and retryable failure are separate design states.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/GridRow
records.description: Reusable data row composed of selection and cell instances. Row selection and active cell focus are separate states.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/DataGrid
records.description: Interactive data grid specification. Includes sorting, filtering, bulk selection, editing, loading, empty and failure states, and column visibility controls. Use arrow keys for cells, Enter/F2 to edit and Escape to cancel; maintain one grid tab stop.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/SplitPanels
records.description: Resizable workspace composition with side-by-side and stacked layouts. Includes focused/dragging handles, collapsed panes and both size limits. Restore the previous size after expanding; runtime dragging and keyboard behavior require implementation.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/Picker
records.description: Composed Picker design: Content=Tree or Listbox; Selection=Single or Multiple. Both use the existing shared field and popover components with replaceable content. Tree rows retain independent expansion and selection; selecting a branch does not cascade. Single selection closes on activation; multiple selection updates immediately and Done closes. Escape closes without clearing values; return focus to the trigger. This is a Figma composition proposal, not a new shipped runtime API.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/calendar
records.description: Reusable calendar. October 2026 sample, Monday-first, six complete weeks. Today=24, selected=26; keyboard focus=27. Restricted example disables Oct 1–4. Navigation controls are separate from date cells. Figma design proposal; no runtime component is registered by this design.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/datePicker
records.description: Editable date field with a calendar popover. Reuses the existing field, popover, calendar and button primitives. Joined open surface, shared strong border and 40px field. Distinct from the existing native dateTime example; runtime remains native. Figma design proposal; no runtime component is registered by this design.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/colorPicker
records.description: Color field and shared popover with saturation/value, hue, hex, opacity, RGB readout and recent colors. Hue/swatch values are user color data, not theme tokens. Theme controls use existing Oddkin roles. Custom hex sample #D4466C. Figma design proposal; no runtime component is registered by this design.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/oneTimeCode
records.description: Six-digit code entry reusing one cell primitive. Paste and autofill accept the full code; keyboard uses one logical field with predictable movement. Verifying disables entry, errors explain recovery, success has words and a check. Figma design proposal; no runtime component is registered by this design.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/stepper
records.description: Three-step wizard navigation with numbered, complete, current, upcoming and error states. Narrow example changes the progress track to a vertical stack. Steps report current position; panels and validation remain application content. Figma design proposal; no runtime component is registered by this design.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/timeline
records.description: Chronological activity list with marker, connector, timestamp and event detail. Status uses words and icons. Narrow layout wraps content; examples are newest first. Figma design proposal; no runtime component is registered by this design.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/descriptionList
records.description: Semantic term/value pairs. Horizontal rows use a stable label column; narrow containers stack each term above its value. Long values wrap; missing values use explicit wording. Figma design proposal; no runtime component is registered by this design.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/carousel
records.description: Manual carousel with previous/next controls, named slides, position and direct selection. First and last controls disable at boundaries. No automatic advancement. Keyboard focus is distinct from the displayed slide; announce user-initiated changes without moving focus. Narrow layout retains all controls. Figma design specification; runtime behavior requires implementation.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/hoverCard
records.description: Supplementary profile preview opened by pointer hover or keyboard focus and available through an explicit trigger on touch. Pointer can enter the card; Escape dismisses. Essential information remains available on the profile destination. Interactive content uses a popover rather than tooltip semantics. Figma design specification; runtime behavior requires implementation.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/contextMenu
records.description: Contextual actions reuse the existing Menu and MenuItem primitives. Open by right-click, Shift+F10 or the visible more-actions button. Arrow keys navigate, Enter activates, Escape closes and restores trigger focus. Disabled and destructive actions stay distinct. Figma design specification; runtime behavior requires implementation.

records.name: Oddkin/Common/appHeader
records.description: Application-level header composed from existing actions and navigation. Desktop has brand, primary destinations, search, notifications and account. Narrow layout has an explicit menu trigger; expanded narrow navigation preserves the active destination. Name icon-only controls and expose one banner landmark. Figma design specification; runtime behavior requires implementation.
